name: Social Counter & Sharer
author: Prisna

sections.description:
Ultra-lightweight WordPress plugin that let your visitors share your content on social networks with sleek icons. Display likes and followers counters to boost engagement. Optimized for speed, it ensures minimal impact on your site’s performance while offering a modern, responsive design that fits any theme. Perfect for bloggers and businesses aiming to enhance their social presence effortlessly.

Simple yet powerful tool to display static social network statistics. It supports: Facebook, X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Reddit, TikTok, Vimeo, YouTube, Tumblr and VKontakte.

Also allows to customize the colors and format of the icons using visual controls in the admin panel.

Features:

  • Fully responsive, retina ready and compatible with mobile devices.
  • Sharer supports the 7 major social networks: Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Reddit, Tumblr and VKontakte.
  • Counter supports the 11 major platforms: Facebook, X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Reddit, TikTok, Vimeo, YouTube, Tumblr and VKontakte.
  • Set the order of enabled social networks.
  • Import/Export settings to easily transfer configurations.
  • For feature requests, please contact us.

Support:

  • Create a ticket here in the WordPress support forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/social-counter
  • Or you can also ask for assistance directly from our website: https://www.prisna.net/contact-us/
sections.installation:
1. Go to the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Click Plugins, then Add New, then Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the downloaded zip file, install it and activate it.
  4. A new entry will appear under the Plugins main menu: Social Counter & Sharer.
  5. Set options at will.

Social Sharer:

  1. Enabled by default on the left side of the screen, middle centered.

Social Counter:

  1. Either go to the Widgets admin page, or use the shortcode on your pages, posts and any other WordPress resource.
